title: Service Coordinator
description: Transport Service Coordinator Salary: Competitive salary with an annual performance bonus (15%) plus Veolia benefits and pension Hours: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, 8:30am - 5pm Location: Portsmouth When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone. It's why we're looking for someone who's just as committed as we are, to push for genuine change and bring our ambition of Ecological Transformation to life. We know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment, and contribute to our inclusive culture. What we can offer you; - 25 days of annual leave - Access to our company pension scheme - Stream - Employee financial wellbeing support: early access to your earned pay, savings, budgeting, financial coaching & rewards - Discounts on everything from groceries to well known retailers - Access to a range of resources to support your physical, mental and financial health; so you can lean on us whenever you need to - One paid days leave every year to volunteer and support your community - Ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to reach your full potential Key elements of the role include; - Day-to-day management of service delivery, including the dynamic allocation of work to vehicles/routes. Route planning, analysing data, setting schedules and coordinating a team of drivers. - Communicating with customers and stakeholders, providing status updates and maintaining contact with drivers - Completing debriefs with front line staff and reporting necessary actions or updates as required - Face-to-face and telephone engagement with drivers, supporting them to address any issues on route - Reporting of all safety concerns or container damage and encouraging 'stop the job' if it is deemed unsafe to continue - Ensuring Veolia legal compliance on-site (WTD, O'licence and transport compliance) What we're looking for: Essential: - Previous experience operating within a similar industry; waste/transport/logistics - Able to demonstrate an understanding of transport compliance and WTD - Good communication skills, communicating with people of all levels, including drivers, frontline employees and customers - Ability to organise a busy workload and operate at a fast pace - Resilience and confidence to challenge drivers professionally and constructively on performance, compliance, and safety issues Desirable: - Experienced IT Skills, and the ability to adapt to Google operating systems - Experience working with a quality management system e.g. ISO Managing transport compliance What's next? Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come. We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career. We're dedicated to supporting you throughout your application journey, offering adjustments where reasonable and appropriate. As a proud Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to applicants with a disability or long-term condition who opt-in to the Disability Confident scheme, and meet the minimum criteria for our roles. We're also committed to ensuring that all applicants and colleagues receive fair treatment without discrimination on any grounds, aiming to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Hire Coordinator
description: Hire Coordinator - Ringwood Dovetail Recruitment are excited to be working with a growing construction business in Ringwood, who are recruiting due to their ever growing team! With full training and support given across all facets of the business, there is real career progression on offer for the right person, with the potential of the role evolving into additional areas over time. The Hire Desk Assistant is a vital part of the operations for both Sales and Customer Services. On a day-to-day basis, you can expect to be desk-based, making regular contact with stock teams, sales reps and various depots around the UK to ensure minimal delay in fulfilling the needs of the customer. Duties & Responsibilities: - Receiving enquiries from customers, and actioning, processing orders and following them through to completion - Arranging delivery and collection of orders in according with the customer s and Sale Teams requirements. - Managing Sub Contracted Transport suppliers, their service levels and constant monitoring of their costs - Using an established database of 3rd party suppliers and hauliers to arrange transport of products to and from the depots and where possible, reducing handling and increasing profit margins on Transport. - Safeguarding that all products hired to customers are safe and have been properly tested in accordance with company procedures, where necessary all relevant Test Certification are raised and sent with products being Hired. This is a fast-paced position where the Hire Coordinator will build your knowledge of company services, relationships with key partners and colleagues, and problem solve along the way. The business takes great pride in not only their convenience for their customers, but their level of service, making you proud to be a part of the team. Minimum Experience Required: - Strong communication skills - Well organised with a keen eye for detail - Ability to multitask - Team Player Salary & Details - 20 days holiday + bank holidays - Free Parking - Monday Friday 8.30am 5pm - 1 hour lunch - Pension contributions This Hire Coordinator role presents an outstanding opportunity for individuals who are eager, dependable, and conscientious, with ample room for career growth. If you are interested in this Hire Coordinator job in Ringwood, please click on Apply Now or alternatively give us a call on (phone number removed) and ask for Laura. title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Our clients Customer Service team plays a vital role in delivering an outstanding experience to customers. This is a varied and fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of customer issues, contribute ideas for service improvements, and make a genuine difference to the customer experience. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about helping others and committed to delivering exceptional service. Salary: Up To £28,000 FTE, £24,000 per annum for a 30 hr contract Working Hours: You will be required to work on a shift rotation basis of 5 days across Monday to Sunday Candidates would be expected to work rotation shifts across the following hours: 7am-3.30pm, 8.30am-5pm, 9am-5.30pm and 11.30am-8pm Key Responsibilities - Deliver excellent customer service via telephone, email, live chat, and social media channels. - Take ownership of customer enquiries and provide effective solutions in a timely manner. - Maintain high standards of service and continuously seek ways to improve the customer experience. - Handle customer complaints professionally and escalate issues where appropriate. - Support continuous improvement initiatives within the customer service function. - Identify opportunities to improve processes, procedures, and workflows. - Work collaboratively within a dynamic and supportive team environment. About You - Previous customer service experience is essential. - Contact centre experience is beneficial but not required. - Confident communicating with customers across a range of channels, particularly by telephone. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. - Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly. - Resilient and able to manage challenging customer interactions with professionalism and empathy. - Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset. - Competent IT skills and confidence using multiple systems and applications.

If you would like to hear more about this exciting opportunity and make your mark in a fast-paced, supportive, and growing business, please APPLY NOW!
